protocol: HEEDB I0006 independent corrected-pipeline confirmation v1
status: preregistered and frozen before confirmation outcome access or inference
study_type: one independent disjoint patient-sample confirmation; no training or method search
population: HEEDB I0006 Emory; 10000 new patients, one ECG each, no patient in v1/corrected-v2 evaluation or the 23 readiness records
selection: Use the prior frozen candidate order, which already chose one ECG per patient by a label-blind record hash after filtering missing patient IDs and empty physician-code fields. Read only patient ID, FileName and remote stem. Exclude all v1/v2 and readiness patient IDs. Sort remaining patients by SHA256('heedb_independent_confirmation_v1|2026-09-24|patient_hash'|'|'|BDSPPatientID), then patient ID; take first 10000. No rate, quality, label or prediction stratification. If any frozen selected waveform is unreadable, stop rather than substitute a new record.
outcome_access: No confirmation diagnosis code values read until selected manifest and this full protocol were hashed. After freeze, join selected FileName one-to-one to diagnoses_acquisition.csv and use codes_physician only; no software or v24 label merge.
primary_endpoint: three matched-seed mean of physics-aware minus baseline core-TWA AUPRC under exact simulated RA_LL_reversal; paired patient-level percentile 95% interval
prespecified_secondary: Core-TWA clean AUPRC, AUROC, frozen-threshold sensitivity and specificity, predicted-positive fraction, mean score, Brier score and 15-bin ECE; same clean and RA-LL diagnostics for core SB, core STach, strict TWA and strict SB. Three seed-level results and means; arm and condition contrasts for AUPRC, sensitivity and specificity, with paired intervals. No 24-mask panel in this bounded confirmation.
sampling_and_units: Read the selected HEEDB .hea/.dat with frozen v1 WFDB reader; require mV and canonical 12-lead order; convert mV x1000 to microvolts; resample original 250Hz 2500 samples up 2 to 500Hz 5000 samples, leave original 500Hz 5000 samples, then v2 ::5 to exact (12,1000) effective 100Hz input.
reversal: Call the existing src.ecg_physics.named_reversal(independent I,II,V1-V6,'RA_LL_reversal') and derive_display through v2.normalized_conditions; apply before frozen per-lead Ningbo normalization. This is a simulated electrical cable swap, not an observed wiring error.
normalization: Use each frozen checkpoint's unchanged Ningbo preprocessing.npz mean/std; no HEEDB re-estimation.
model_artifacts: The 18 six-checkpoint/preprocessing/validation hashes bound inside the above immutable corrected-v2 protocol must all revalidate on every stage; source ECGResNet architecture is verified by the v1 frozen model loader.
bootstrap: 1000 synchronized with-replacement patient-index samples using numpy default_rng seed 20260924; same resampled patient indices for both arms, all three seeds and both conditions; report percentile 2.5 and 97.5 intervals, with seed-level contrasts averaged after each resample.
transfer_gate: Use only exact large-repository S3 alias and non-root bdsp-reader IAM identity. HEAD only the 20000 selected .hea/.dat objects; verify STANDARD storage, no RequestCharged response, exact sizes, local reuse, <=2 GiB needed. Estimate ordinary S3 owner-side cost at $0.09/decimal GB internet egress plus $0.0004/1000 Standard GET and HEAD requests, ignoring free tier/discounts; stop before transfer if estimate >$0.25 or billing/size cannot be determined safely. Never use RequestPayer or broader S3 permissions. Downloads are size-verified and resumable; no duplicate job.
engineering_gate: Three automated tests of exact (12,1000) sampling, all 12 RA-LL leads including aVR/aVF, and normalization order. Smoke on the 23 excluded readiness ECGs across all six models and clean/exact-RA-LL, finite three-channel probabilities, before confirmation inference.
no_adaptation: No new training, model or threshold tuning, mapping changes, calibration, sample substitution, interim-outcome response, or wider method search.
aggregate_location: outputs/heedb_independent_confirmation_v1/; public results and progress contain aggregates only
interpretation: Independent confirmation of simulated electrical reversal under physician-overread HEEDB proxy labels, not verified real-world lead misplacement or exact Chapman/Ningbo SNOMED-label replication. Report unfavorable sensitivity/specificity tradeoffs plainly.
